en:
Rantaro was with us during the strategy
meeting in the basement, until he left.

Moments later, we discovered him in the
library, so it was before the time limit.
...Did you forget because it's been awhile?

<CLT=cltMIND>I made a mistake...
I need to think it over again! <CLT=cltNORMAL>

What? Rantaro was trying to expose
the mastermind and end the killing game.

Geez! Don't go and say whatever
you want about him just cuz he's dead.

<CLT=cltMIND>I made a mistake...
I need to think it over again! <CLT=cltNORMAL>

Umm... His cause of death was blunt 
force to the back of the head, right?

I'm pretty sure it was because of
the shot put ball, but...

<CLT=cltMIND>I made a mistake...
I need to think it over again! <CLT=cltNORMAL>

Oh? Kaede activated her fully automatic
killing machine from the classroom, right?

If someone had been there, they would've
witnessed the murder!

You need a more serious argument than
that to keep things exciting!

<CLT=cltMIND>I made a mistake...
I need to think it over again! <CLT=cltNORMAL>

<CLT=cltMIND>No... After Rantaro was killed,
someone would've come to the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>There is evidence that
proves that...

<CLT=cltMIND>Rantaro was the only one at the scene...
That's what we concluded at the first trial.
<CLT=cltMIND>But was it really true?
